name: Tyk
summary: Tyk is an API gateway with an open source core under the MPL 2.0 license. Its developer portal is included in both listed paid plans. Rate limits can be set per key, per API and per endpoint, and auth tokens can be sent as bearer tokens. The pricing page lists no prices, billing periods or currency, and says plans are quoted on request.

facts.text: The pricing page lists Tyk Gateway as included in the Core and Professional plans, and says the gateway is open source under the MPL 2.0 license.
The pricing page says the Developer Portal is included in both the Core and Professional plans.
The pricing page lists no prices, billing periods or currency for any plan, and says Tyk sales quotes plans on request.
The rate limit documentation says rate limits can be set per key, per API and per endpoint, and that requests over the rate limit receive HTTP 429.
The authentication documentation says the Auth Token method works like a bearer token, and that the client can send it in a header, query parameter or cookie.

plans.name: Core
plans.unit: usage-based, by the number of APIs managed
plans.notes: No price on the page. Includes unlimited APIs and API calls, and the Developer Portal.

plans.name: Professional
plans.unit: architecture-based, by data planes, environments and control planes
plans.notes: No price on the page. Includes unlimited APIs and API calls, and the Developer Portal.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: No price on the page. Adds premium support and custom SLAs.

hiddenCosts: The pricing page lists no prices, billing periods or currency for any plan.
The pricing page says plans are quoted on request, so the cost of each plan is not known from the page.
